name: SUSE Certified Engineer in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15

logistics.format: Question-based proctored exam covering encryption, shell scripting, advanced networking, storage, Salt configuration management

formal: Hold the SCA in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 12 or 15 certification

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The SCA prerequisite, three-year profile and advanced encryption, networking and automation scope support professional operations; knowledge-only assessment and SUSE dependence limit expert implementation inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The SCA prerequisite, advanced encryption, scripting, networking and configuration scope support professional system operations at the three-year profile. The question-based exam does not directly establish practical troubleshooting or security response mastery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded prerequisite administrator credential and advanced networking, scripting and configuration topics add depth. I discount a higher engineer-level interpretation because the assessment remains multiple choice and lacks practical delivery.
